rationale: The plan correctly identifies the condition:time interaction as the target and implements it via DESeq2 LRT of full (~condition+time+condition:time) vs reduced (~condition+time), with limma-voom as a concordance check and a secondary continuous-time model, all explicitly justified against the 2x4x3 design and its df. QC (alignment, cross-tab of cell sizes, PCA/heatmap/library sizes) precedes testing, with an explicit outlier/discrepancy policy. Filtering (>=10 counts in >=3 samples) is minimal and justified, and normalization is left to DESeq2/limma internal size factors/TMM with raw counts as input, never pre-normalizing. BH FDR at stated alpha with apeglm/ashr shrinkage for per-timepoint effects is well specified, and thresholds are built into the test rather than post hoc. Enrichment correctly uses the filtered universe for ORA and a signed ranking for GSEA, naming collections and stating a size caveat; the only minor gaps are the lack of explicit collection version numbers and no fixed size window for gene sets, and the report step, while thorough, does not fully name specific software version numbers up front.
